result.title: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
result.summary: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LightHarness，一个基于 VLM 的 agentic 框架，将显式光照推理引入迭代式 image-to-code 3D 场景重建，联合几何、本征与光照线索精修场景，并用 Lighting Reasoning Memory 维护光源假设与修订历史。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「假设记忆＋证据引导验证」可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、迭代状态维护与停止决策提供方法线索，但输出为显式代码，未涉及内部 latent 推理状态，需核查其验证与修订机制的可迁移性。
